labeled assumption: the standby public builder (memo 4 B as decided, DEC-2026-11-13-10; CLI-10.03) as the engine's federal grid program at this fraction of its full strength (transmission growth +0.8 points a year, +15 GW a year of reconductoring access, wider usable wind and solar, $12B a year; SRC-0077, v2.5): it builds only where utilities and transmission developers fail to act within a year, at competitive cost. 1.0 would be a builder everywhere (memo 4 option A)

calibrated (HI-1): the spread of fuel prices plants act on, as a multiple of the spread EIA measures across states (SRC-5058 to SRC-5061); contracts, plants that must run and differences within a state widen it. Fitted to 2015-2020 power history and tested on 2023-2025; the largest multiple that keeps coal's recalibrated running cost near the engine's sourced $4/MWh (SRC-0077): 1.5 gives $3.59, 2.0 gives $1.65
